title: fix(metadata-protocol,rest): a .custom pair's declared override is labelled in the ruled order on every /meta read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6HN9TS7GFoRJmsKPyPbpwW)_

domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：客户在 `<基础包>.custom` 配对包里覆盖了基础包的页面、数据集、应用或书（仪表盘、视图、报表同样适用），改过的标签现在在所有 `/meta` 读上按裁定顺序显示：配对包自己的译文优先，其次是覆盖项自己写的文字，最后才是基础包的译文。
- 为什么改：以前页面、数据集、应用、书的覆盖项在非源语言下被基础包的译文盖住，客户改的名字看不到；七类覆盖项都不读配对包自己发布的译文。
- 风险与回滚：只有声明覆盖项多一次读，读的是配对包的 active translation 行，列表按基础包每次请求只读一次；不是覆盖项的条目没有新增读。回滚即撤本 PR，没有数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 的 `pairTranslationBundleOf` 和 `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` 新加的四行，再看 `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts` 的 `getPairTranslationBundle`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-dashboard-view-i18n-explicit-override.test.ts`，预期 108 条全绿；修复前的代码上有 19 条是红的。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30062

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` gains six public methods, `getPackagedPageBase`, `getPackagedDatasetBase`, `getPackagedAppBase`, `getPackagedBookBase`, `servedOverrideBaseOf` and `getPairTranslationBundle` (measured on the built `packages/metadata-protocol/dist/index.d.ts`); `@objectstack/rest`'s exported `MetaBookTreeSources` accepts one more optional key, `resolveProtocol` (measured on the built `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts`). REST's new `pairTranslationBundleOf` is module-internal: it is not in the package's export list. Nothing accepted is taken away.
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — the "Customizing an installed package (ADR-0146)" paragraph of `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` says nothing about how an override's labels are translated, so no sentence there turns false; its stale served-type list is #30229's.

## What changes

The spec half (PR #30236, #30193) gave every document translator `packagedBase` and `pairBundle`. Its "Server-half contract for #30062", quoted:

> For a served item that is a declared `.custom` override, on item, list and container reads alike, for all eight types:
>
> - `packagedBase` = the BASE package's item (pre-override: the document the override replaces), never the override itself;
> - `pairBundle` = `{ locale: data }` built from that `.custom` package's own translations only: its code-shipped translation bundle and its authored `translation` rows, both of which are the pair's own;
> - keep passing `packagedBase` for object, dashboard, view and report exactly as today, on every served item (`PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS`, `form-routes.ts` :385 :421): the object reads it for extension-folded field labels too (ADR-0029 D9.2a, #27559), so it is not override-only. Add the same accessor for page, dataset, app and book;
> - omit `pairBundle` for an item that is not a declared override.

This PR is that server half, with the seat's rulings on where the contract does not fit the code (Deviations below).

**`packagedBase` for page, dataset, app and book.** Four protocol accessors, `getPackagedPageBase` / `getPackagedDatasetBase` / `getPackagedAppBase` / `getPackagedBookBase`, answer the base package's own item through the same shadow-immune lookup `getPackagedDashboardBase` / `ViewBase` / `ReportBase` use (`packagedArtifactBase`, now typed over the seven artifact types). They answer the base's item while the override is served, right after it is published and after a restart, and `undefined` for an unknown name. `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` in the REST read gate gains the four rows, so `GET /meta/:type/:name` and `GET /meta/:type` hand them to the translators. `action` is now the one translatable type without a row.

**`pairBundle` for a declared override.** `servedOverrideBaseOf(type, document)` names the base a served document overrides: an overridable type, an `overrides.package`, and a served `_packageId` equal to it (the envelope `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` stamps on a served override). Anything else, a base's own item included, answers `undefined`. `getPairTranslationBundle(base)` reads that base's pair's own active `translation` rows (`package_id` = `customizationPackageId(base)`) through `readAuthoredTranslationLayer`, the same reader the i18n service's authored layer uses (conversions, locale resolution and bookkeeping stripped), and answers `{ locale: data }`, or `undefined` when the pair has none, the id is empty or invalid, or the read fails. The REST gate's `pairTranslationBundleOf` joins the two, feature-detected on the protocol, and passes the result as `pairBundle` on the item read and on every listed item. A list reads each base's pair once per request.

**The book tree.** `createMetaBookTreeAnswer` forced `resolveProtocol` to `undefined`, so `GET /meta/book/:name/tree` translated a book with no packaged base. `MetaBookTreeSources` now takes the transport's `resolveProtocol`, and the RestServer route passes it. The runtime dispatcher's tree sources already spread it. The docs sidebar and the book list now serve the same label (#26690).

## Deviations

- **`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts`** (+2): the book tree route's sources, outside the dispatched surface; widened by the seat for the tree fix above.
- **`packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`** (+93, test only): the real-boot pins reuse #29613's sealed-boot fixture there. They cannot live in `packages/metadata-protocol`: it does not depend on `@objectstack/objectql` (objectql depends on it), so the import would be a cycle. Widened by the seat.
- **`scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`** (+5 / -1, generated): `check:engine-double-contract` ratchets the two new `findOne` doubles the new pins assert (`protocol.pair-translation-bundle.test.ts` 0 → 1, `meta-dashboard-view-i18n-explicit-override.test.ts` 1 → 2), written by `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`. Coverage grew; nothing else in the ledger moved.
- **No code translation source.** The contract names the pair's "code-shipped translation bundle". A `.custom` package is authored, never a code package, so it has none; and code bundles reach the i18n service's static layer with no package provenance. `pairBundle` is built from the pair's active `translation` rows only (seat ruling).
- **Seven types, not eight.** An object is extended, never replaced (ADR-0146 D10): it carries no declared override, so `servedOverrideBaseOf` answers `undefined` for it and no object read takes a `pairBundle`. Its `packagedBase` is passed exactly as before.
- **Not covered here.** The view container read builds its slots without the served-override envelope, so `servedOverrideBaseOf` answers `undefined` there and the slots keep today's `packagedBase` order. `form-routes.ts` (public form views) is outside the surface and is unchanged: it still passes `packagedBase`, with no `pairBundle`.
- **A package-less authored translation** is in the deployment catalog but is not the pair's, so it no longer outranks a changed label on a declared override. That is the ruled order (6631250894: only the pair's translation ranks first).

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-dashboard-view-i18n-explicit-override.test.ts` (real `SchemaRegistry` and protocol over fake engine rows, through `RestServer`): §1 now asks each of the eight accessor rows, the four new ones included, and asks no accessor for `action`, `flow`, a plural and a prototype key. New §5 over page, dataset, app, book and view: an override's own label beats the base's translation (`zh-CN` and `en`); a translation the pair ships wins in `zh-CN` while `en` reads the override's label, on the item and the list read; no override reads the base's translation; a member reads what an admin reads; the book tree serves the label the book list serves for three seeds. 19 red on the pre-fix code, 108/108 after.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`: a real boot, page / app / dataset / book, with and without a metadata service: each accessor answers the base's item before the override, right after it and after a restart; `servedOverrideBaseOf` answers the base on the served and listed items and nothing on the base's own; `getPairTranslationBundle` is `undefined` before, then exactly the pair's saved translation beside a package-less row of the same key, and `undefined` for the pair's own id; fed to `translateMetadataDocument` the three give pair → own → base. 16 new, file 87/87.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.test.ts` (`servedOverrideBaseOf` table) and the new `protocol.pair-translation-bundle.test.ts` (pair rows only, every read naming `package_id`, bookkeeping stripped, `undefined` with no read for an empty, invalid or pair id, `undefined` on a read failure): 15/15. Its fake engine refuses any operator or combinator, holds the caller's `limit` after the filter, and opens `findOne` with `assertEngineFindOnePredicate`.

## Ablations

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. A metadata-protocol mutation was rebuilt and proved in `dist/` with `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` (exit 0) before the objectql and rest legs, which read its `dist/`; after the last one a clean rebuild was proved free of all three markers (`--absent`, exit 0).

| | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | the four new `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` rows deleted | rest 18/108 |
| A2 | `pairTranslationBundleOf` never fetches | rest 11/108 |
| A3 | the book tree route's `resolveProtocol` deleted | rest 1/108 (tree == list) |
| A4 | `servedOverrideBaseOf` always `undefined` | mp 1/15, objectql 8/87, rest 11/108 |
| A5 | the pair's `package_id` filter dropped | mp 2/15, objectql 8/87 |
| A6 | `getPackagedBookBase` answers `undefined` | objectql 4/87, rest 4/108 |

A5's first run left objectql green: the layer merges rows in name order, and the package-less row sorted before the pair's, so its text never showed. The row was renamed to sort after the pair's, and the pin now goes red.

## Docs

`content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`, "An edit beats the packaged catalog": the bullet "An edited string is served in the language it was written in, to every reader" is false for a declared override whose pair translates the string. It now names that exception, and a new paragraph states the order for a declared override (page, dataset, app, book, dashboard, view, report; the pair's translations first; only `translation` items saved in the pair; the item, list and book tree reads agree). `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` and `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx` were read sentence by sentence: neither says how an override's labels are translated, so neither changes.
